verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is a self-hosted AI platform, so credential handling is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents a secrets store, env-based secret separation, or redaction of keys from chat history. Personal API access tokens (docs-2) and coding-agent backends that reuse an existing CLI login with "no API key needed" (docs-60) are adjacent features, not the deliberate credential handling the story asks for.
